c013.title: Baking for Grandma
c013.story: Anna and her mom bake for Grandma's birthday. First they put all the [[ingredients|ingredient]] on the table. Anna weighs two hundred [[grams|gram]] of flour. They have no sugar, so honey is their [[substitute]]. Mom adds [[cinnamon]] and a spoon of vanilla [[extract]]. Anna turns on the [[mixer]], and Mom sets the [[timer]]. Soon twelve [[cupcakes|cupcake]] come out of the oven. Anna puts pink [[icing]] on each one. Then they make a [[cheesecake]] and a tray of [[brownies|brownie]]. Mom bakes an apple [[tart]], and Anna makes chocolate [[fudge]] with [[pecans|pecan]]. Last, they make Grandma's favorite [[red velvet]] cake. In the evening, Grandma tries everything and smiles.

c014.title: A barbecue at the dacha
c014.story: On Saturday Anna's family has a [[barbecue]] at the dacha. Dad connects the [[propane]] tank carefully. He checks the [[regulator]] twice. Then he cooks [[hamburgers|hamburger]] and [[hot dogs|hot dog]] for everyone. Later he puts a big piece of [[roast beef]] on the [[grill]]. After a day in the garden, everyone has a huge [[appetite]]. The kids drink cold [[lemonade]] in the shade. In the evening they roast [[marshmallows|marshmallow]] over the fire. Nobody wants to go back to the city.

c015.title: Dinner at an Italian restaurant
c015.story: Max takes Anna to an Italian restaurant for her birthday. The [[hostess]] smiles and shows them to a table by the window. Max orders a glass of [[pinot]], and Anna asks for water. Max chooses [[spaghetti]], and Anna wants [[ravioli]]. The chef makes all the [[pasta]] by hand. They also share a [[risotto]] with [[parmesan]] and black [[truffle]]. For dessert, they have chocolate [[mousse]]. Max drinks an [[espresso]] and pays the bill. "Best birthday ever," says Anna.

c016.title: Mom's comfort food
c016.story: After a hard week, Anna goes home to her parents. She arrives just as Mom takes dinner out of the oven. "Perfect [[timing]]!" says Mom. Tonight it's all Anna's favorite [[comfort food]]. They eat outside on the [[patio]]. There is hot [[lasagna]] and a bowl of [[mac and cheese]]. Dad loves the pasta [[alfredo]] most. Grandma's apple pie is made with [[lard]], like in the old days. For dessert there is chocolate [[pudding]] and cherry jelly with [[gelatin]]. Dad drinks a little [[brandy]] after dinner. Mom puts the rest of the food in Anna's [[lunch box]].

c017.title: Street food Saturday
c017.story: Anna and Max walk to a [[food market]] by the river. They want to try some [[street food]]. Max buys a big [[kebab]] first. Anna gets two [[tacos|taco]] and a [[burrito]] from a [[food truck]]. The cook makes warm [[tortillas|tortilla]] right in front of them. They also buy chips with [[guacamole]] and a spicy cheese [[dip]]. Max's face turns red, and he drinks a whole bottle of water. "Too hot for you?" Anna laughs.

c018.title: Happy hour
c018.story: After a long week, Max's new colleagues invite him to [[happy hour]]. They meet at a small [[bar]], and Anna comes too. The [[bartender]] is fast and friendly. He makes [[cocktails|cocktail]] for everyone. Oleh orders a [[martini]]. Max asks for a [[gin]] and [[tonic]] with [[lime]]. Iryna drinks a [[lite]] beer. Anna doesn't drink [[alcohol]], so she orders orange juice. By the end of the evening, Max knows everyone's name.

c019.title: Quiz night at the pub
c019.story: Every Thursday there is a [[quiz]] at an Irish [[pub]] in town. Anna, Max and their friends make a team. The [[barman]] brings [[ale]] and [[cider]] from a new [[keg]]. Anna drinks tea and answers all the history questions. Between rounds, they play [[darts]]. Max misses the board every time. Then he plays [[snooker]] and wins easily. At the end, their team gets second place and a free pizza.

c020.title: A new sweater
c020.story: Anna loves [[shopping]]. Today she goes to a big [[shopping center]]. She needs a warm [[sweater]] for winter. In a shop window, she sees a [[mannequin]]. It wears a nice red one. It is on [[sale]]! Anna asks for the same [[model]] in blue. It is soft [[cotton]], not [[nylon]] or [[polyester]]. She also gets a student [[discount]]. She pays in [[cash]] and smiles.

c021.title: Max needs a new look
c021.story: Max wants a new [[style]], but he knows nothing about [[fashion]]. So Anna takes him to a small [[boutique]] in the city center. A shop assistant comes up to them. "Can I help you, [[madam]]?" she asks Anna. "Yes, my friend needs a new [[outfit]]," Anna says. First she chooses a gray [[hoodie]] from a good [[brand]]. Then she finds a [[denim]] jacket and [[baggy]] jeans. She also adds a white [[tank top]] and a green [[beanie]]. Max looks in the mirror and smiles. "Maybe I need a [[tattoo]] now," he says. "And a [[piercing]]?" Anna laughs. "One step at a time!"

c022.title: At the beauty salon
c022.story: Anna has a big party on Saturday. In the morning, she goes to a beauty [[salon]]. Her [[stylist]], Olena, is very kind. She does the [[styling]] with a little hair [[gel]]. Then Anna gets a [[manicure]]. After that, a nice hand [[cream]] makes her skin soft. At home, Anna does her [[makeup]] with [[mascara]] and [[eyeliner]]. Next door to the salon, Max goes to the [[barber]]. He sits next to a man with a big [[afro]]. At the party, Anna and Max both look great.

c023.title: A present for Mom
c023.story: Anna and her brother Taras need a birthday present for Mom. They go to a small jewelry shop. First they look at white [[pearls|pearl]]. Then Taras finds a silver [[bracelet]] and a gold [[medallion]]. There are rings with a [[sapphire]], an [[opal]] and an [[amethyst]]. Everything is very expensive! An [[expert]] in the shop is very helpful. He explains what a [[carat]] is. Then he shows them a beautiful [[crystal]] on a thin chain. It is pretty and not expensive, so they buy it. Mom loves her present.

c024.title: Anna's student budget
c024.story: Today Anna counts her money. Her parents send her a hundred [[dollars|dollar]]. She has 50 more: 100 [[plus]] 50 is 150. Books cost 40, and 150 [[minus]] 40 is 110. Anna is on a tight [[budget]]. She saves every [[cent]] and every [[penny]]. On Monday she goes to the [[bank]]. She checks her [[balance]] and makes a [[deposit]]. Anna wants a new phone. But she does not buy it on [[credit]]. She saves for it instead.
